status: proposed design weights, NOT an installed Java config or measured spawn frequencies
source: Existing Wildforge surface/underground biome designs and resources.zip texture names

units.surface_share: approx percent of overworld LAND biome coverage after climate/shore/geology eligibility constraints (not all-world uniform random choice)
units.surface_top: percentage of eligible exposed SOLID land columns in a biome; coherent weighted patches; percent sums to 100
units.soil_under: percentage composition over chosen soil_depth_min_max blocks beneath land surface; patch-based; sums to 100
units.rock_bias: advisory shallow geology texture distribution only; deep host rocks follow regional geology, independent of climate
units.trees: attempts or mature trees per eligible 16x16 surface area; tree geometry and species crowns separate
units.plants: target plants/clumps per eligible 16x16 surface area; respect slope/light/water filters
units.cave_share: approx percent of assigned CAVE volumes among 12 cave types, after depth and geology eligibility; cannot be guaranteed globally
units.cave_wall: percentage of naturally exposed cave-wall/ceiling SOLID blocks, excluding ore veins and separately placed hanging decorations
units.cave_floor: percentage of exposed, traversable cave-floor SOLID blocks, excluding water/standalone decorations
units.water: percentage of cave-floor columns beneath water (ranges by layout), NOT percentage of exposed rock walls
units.ceiling_and_ground: percent of eligible exposed ceiling/floor attachment positions; placed in coherent patches, not independent noisy pixels

surface_biomes.name: Greenheart Forest
surface_biomes.terrain: Rolling deciduous woods, streams, leaf litter and decomposing wood
surface_biomes.subsurface: Dirt over mixed stone; damp mossy pockets
surface_biomes.generation: Place clumped trees on fertile slopes, clear narrow stream corridors, scatter fallen logs in old stands
surface_biomes.feature: Leaf-litter patches beneath tree crowns; moss on shaded slopes; fallen logs 0–2/chunk; streams in valleys.

surface_biomes.name: Needlewood Taiga
surface_biomes.terrain: Evergreen forest on cold uplands, rock and needle litter
surface_biomes.generation: Dense conifer clusters; thinning at treeline, fallen pine cones and boulder clearings
surface_biomes.feature: Needle mats under conifers; stones on exposed ridges; canopy thins with altitude.

surface_biomes.name: Emberleaf Woodland
surface_biomes.terrain: Seasonally golden deciduous hills
surface_biomes.subsurface: Loam and stone with occasional clay pockets
surface_biomes.generation: Use red or gold leaf variants by local climate/season; short slopes and uneven canopy patches
surface_biomes.feature: Orange/red/gold canopy localized by tree/season; leaf litter near tree clusters.

surface_biomes.name: Sunmeadow Plains
surface_biomes.terrain: Open grasslands, gentle knolls, meadow pockets
surface_biomes.subsurface: Deep productive soil then mixed sediment
surface_biomes.generation: Keep sightlines; cluster flowers and grain on fertile patches, isolated trees by stream
surface_biomes.feature: Most ground stays visible grass; flowers occur in coherent meadow patches; trees near waterways.

surface_biomes.name: Frostspire Highlands
surface_biomes.terrain: Windy alpine ridges, cliff faces, snowfields and scree
surface_biomes.subsurface: Slate in uplifted belts; mountain rock and sparse ores
surface_biomes.generation: Altitude/latitude-driven snow, scree below cliffs, overhangs and alpine patches on sheltered slopes
surface_biomes.feature: Snow overlays: exposed cold surfaces 20–80% by altitude; scree below cliffs; vegetation only protected ledges.

surface_biomes.name: Frostmoor Tundra
surface_biomes.terrain: Open frozen plains with frost-crusted soils
surface_biomes.subsurface: Frozen peat above coarse sediment and stone
surface_biomes.generation: Low plants, permafrost bands, shallow ice pockets with sparse sheltering shrubs
surface_biomes.feature: Patchy snow and exposed frozen peat, small ice ponds only in depressions.

surface_biomes.name: Redscar Badlands
surface_biomes.terrain: Eroded red mesas, cliffs, canyons and dry washes
surface_biomes.subsurface: Red sedimentary layers and iron-stained stone
surface_biomes.generation: Stratified formations, canyon walls, exposed iron veins and flat-topped mesas
surface_biomes.feature: Mesa and canyon strata use continuous elevation bands, NOT random red-sandstone checkerboards; iron seams localized.

surface_biomes.name: Suncrack Desert
surface_biomes.terrain: Dry dunes, hardpan patches, rocky outcrops and rare oases
surface_biomes.subsurface: Sand, sandstone, gypsum deposits and dry stone
surface_biomes.generation: Dune fields downwind of ridges; hardpan in low basins; rare water-access vegetation
surface_biomes.feature: Dunes from directional height noise; hardpan in basins; cactus clusters sparse, oasis-specific green patches.

surface_biomes.name: Mistfen Wetlands
surface_biomes.terrain: Floodplains, marsh channels, peat bogs and shallow pools
surface_biomes.generation: Low relief, braided shallow water, shore-dependent reeds, trees on dry hummocks
surface_biomes.feature: Water covers 25–45% of lowland columns; reeds by water and lily pads on still water; peat in raised bog patches.

surface_biomes.name: Whitecliff Coast
surface_biomes.terrain: White limestone cliffs, pebbly beaches and tidal coves
surface_biomes.subsurface: Limestone lenses and chalk strata, seawater caves
surface_biomes.generation: Slope-dependent cliffs, beaches at tide level; seaweed underwater, pebble bars near rough coast
surface_biomes.feature: Cliffs have limestone/chalk; beaches use sand/pebbles ONLY below slope and near water; seaweed in shallow water.

surface_biomes.name: Cinderfall Volcanic Fields
surface_biomes.terrain: Rugged basalt, ash, cooled lava beds and hot vents
surface_biomes.subsurface: Basalt flows and magma chambers, vents are rare
surface_biomes.generation: Volcanic geological province controls this biome; hot pockets isolated from starting regions
surface_biomes.feature: Cooled basalt dominates; obsidian confined to old lava contact; hot vents 0–1 per 3–5 chunks and lava 0–3% near active vents.

surface_biomes.name: Hollowstone Karst
surface_biomes.terrain: Limestone plateaus, sinkholes, towers and caves
surface_biomes.subsurface: Limestone caverns, calcite veins and underground streams
surface_biomes.generation: Geology-conditioned overlay: can underlie forest, meadow or coast rather than replacing all surface biomes
surface_biomes.feature: Frequent sinkholes and rock exposures; tree density adapted to climate; calcite in seams rather than vast surface carpets.

surface_biomes.name: Elderroot Grove
surface_biomes.terrain: Rare old-growth oak groves with vaulted crowns, broad root buttresses, mossed logs and shaded floor.
surface_biomes.generation: Giant elder trees use ancient oak variant; 5-12 block canopy clearings and fallen trunks.
surface_biomes.feature: Giant elder trees use ancient oak variant; 5-12 block canopy clearings and fallen trunks.

surface_biomes.name: Brackenwood Thicket
surface_biomes.terrain: Dense, low hardwood thicket with tangled saplings, fern carpets and narrow sightlines.
surface_biomes.generation: Short trees and high understory density; avoid huge trunks.
surface_biomes.feature: Short trees and high understory density; avoid huge trunks.

surface_biomes.name: Mossveil Rainwood
surface_biomes.terrain: Very wet lowland forest with draping foliage, moss on wood and abundant shade-loving plants.
surface_biomes.generation: Moss climbs trunks and stone; ravines and local streams; canopies nearly overlap.
surface_biomes.feature: Moss climbs trunks and stone; ravines and local streams; canopies nearly overlap.

surface_biomes.name: Fernshade Ravine
surface_biomes.terrain: Steep and shadowed, stream-carved fern gullies beneath mixed hardwood forest.
surface_biomes.generation: Required erosion corridor: 6-20 block gullies; ferns on ledges, no trees in steep channel bottom.
surface_biomes.feature: Required erosion corridor: 6-20 block gullies; ferns on ledges, no trees in steep channel bottom.

surface_biomes.name: Silverpine Barrens
surface_biomes.terrain: Sparse upland pine woodland on thin stony soils with pale lichen and open, windy ridges.
surface_biomes.generation: Low crown density, isolated tall pines, rocky crest clearings.
surface_biomes.feature: Low crown density, isolated tall pines, rocky crest clearings.

surface_biomes.name: Snowmantle Woods
surface_biomes.terrain: Snow-laden pine forest below permanent alpine tundra, with snowdrifts and pockets of frozen soil.
surface_biomes.generation: Snow accumulation is slope/aspect biased; snow overlay under pine branches.
surface_biomes.feature: Snow accumulation is slope/aspect biased; snow overlay under pine branches.

surface_biomes.name: Goldgrass Steppe
surface_biomes.terrain: Broad dry temperate grassland with sun-faded grasses, shallow soils and very few trees.
surface_biomes.generation: Windswept rolling grass; long bare sightlines and dry patches in low relief.
surface_biomes.feature: Windswept rolling grass; long bare sightlines and dry patches in low relief.

surface_biomes.name: Briarfield Heath
surface_biomes.terrain: Windy upland heath of poor soils, heathy scrub, scattered flowers and eroded rock.
surface_biomes.generation: Scrub forms broad patches on breezy crests; narrow wooded gullies.
surface_biomes.feature: Scrub forms broad patches on breezy crests; narrow wooded gullies.

surface_biomes.name: Thornscrub Savanna
surface_biomes.terrain: Warm semiarid mosaic of open hardpan, hardy shrubs and isolated gnarled oaks.
surface_biomes.generation: Trees clump close to seasonal channels; drought-resistant plants otherwise.
surface_biomes.feature: Trees clump close to seasonal channels; drought-resistant plants otherwise.

surface_biomes.name: Mistbloom Meadow
surface_biomes.terrain: Flower-rich, moist riverside meadow with dew, low grasses, reeds and almost no canopy.
surface_biomes.generation: Tame broad floodplain grass with large mixed flower carpets, shallow seasonal puddles.
surface_biomes.feature: Tame broad floodplain grass with large mixed flower carpets, shallow seasonal puddles.

surface_biomes.name: Blackwater Bog
surface_biomes.terrain: Dark acidic peat bog with low islands, still pools and sparse cypress growth.
surface_biomes.generation: 40-60% still dark pools in bog basins; trees rooted on peat islands.
surface_biomes.feature: 40-60% still dark pools in bog basins; trees rooted on peat islands.

surface_biomes.name: Floodroot Forest
surface_biomes.terrain: Floodplain hardwood forest with exposed roots, muddy channels, high willow crowns and damp hollows.
surface_biomes.generation: Branching side channels and raised tree hummocks; rooted trees tolerate shallow water.
surface_biomes.feature: Branching side channels and raised tree hummocks; rooted trees tolerate shallow water.

surface_biomes.name: Reedwater Delta
surface_biomes.terrain: Coastal and river-mouth delta of shifting sandbars, silt islands, reed beds and shallow channels.

surface_biomes.feature: Braided tidal and freshwater channels; reeds on sheltered shallow banks.

surface_biomes.name: Stormbreak Coast
surface_biomes.terrain: Storm-worn dark rocky coastline of slate bluffs, gravel coves and sea spray.
surface_biomes.generation: Wave-cut shelves, sea arches and windward bare cliffs; pebble coves in shelter.
surface_biomes.feature: Wave-cut shelves, sea arches and windward bare cliffs; pebble coves in shelter.

surface_biomes.name: Saltwind Flats

surface_biomes.feature: Tidal polygons, ephemeral shallow water, dried salt bands above tidal reach.

surface_biomes.name: Sunwash Strand
surface_biomes.terrain: Warm sandy littoral beaches with dunes, shell patches and occasional coastal scrub.
surface_biomes.generation: Dry backshore dunes, wet foreshore and shell drifts; vegetation only landward of tide.
surface_biomes.feature: Dry backshore dunes, wet foreshore and shell drifts; vegetation only landward of tide.

surface_biomes.name: Shalecrest Foothills

surface_biomes.generation: Eroded rock ribs and scree fans; trees cling to sheltered slopes.
surface_biomes.feature: Eroded rock ribs and scree fans; trees cling to sheltered slopes.

surface_biomes.name: Granite Crown

surface_biomes.generation: Bare exposed granitic ridge crests; boulder fields, large cliffs and few plants.
surface_biomes.feature: Bare exposed granitic ridge crests; boulder fields, large cliffs and few plants.

surface_biomes.name: Glimmerfrost Glacier
surface_biomes.terrain: Perennial ice sheets and cracked blue glacial tongues between peaks.
surface_biomes.generation: Glacier flowline ridges and narrow crevasses; limited to very cold upland regions.
surface_biomes.feature: Glacier flowline ridges and narrow crevasses; limited to very cold upland regions.

surface_biomes.name: Vermilion Canyon
surface_biomes.terrain: Deep dry red sandstone canyons with layered cliffs, talus slopes and winding sandy washes.
surface_biomes.generation: Canyon carving requires erosion/height stage; huge stepped cliffs and narrow winding washes.
surface_biomes.feature: Canyon carving requires erosion/height stage; huge stepped cliffs and narrow winding washes.

surface_biomes.name: Sunscorch Saltpan
surface_biomes.terrain: Blinding inland dry salt basin with polygonal crusts, gypsum fringes and shallow seasonal pools.
surface_biomes.generation: Lowest arid basins with large coherent polygonal pans; vegetation nearly absent.
surface_biomes.feature: Lowest arid basins with large coherent polygonal pans; vegetation nearly absent.

surface_biomes.name: Emberglass Wastes
surface_biomes.terrain: Glassy obsidian fields, cooled black lava and isolated hot fractures around old eruption cores.
surface_biomes.generation: Obsidian localized near former lava flows; avoid placing massive lava carpets.
surface_biomes.feature: Obsidian localized near former lava flows; avoid placing massive lava carpets.

surface_biomes.name: Ashenwood Recovery
surface_biomes.terrain: Old volcanic soil colonized by pioneer grasses, sparse pine and patchy green regeneration.
surface_biomes.generation: Successional ecology: sparse pines and moss patches colonize older ash fields.
surface_biomes.feature: Successional ecology: sparse pines and moss patches colonize older ash fields.

underground_biomes.name: Rootlace Hollows
underground_biomes.placement: Shallow below mature forests and old wooded hills; avoid desert and bare alpine summits
underground_biomes.geometry: Short branching pockets beneath soil and tree trunks, low ceilings with root curtains
underground_biomes.notes: Root mats only beneath forested land within 6–18 blocks of surface; organic floor pockets and 0–2 fallen branch clusters/room.

underground_biomes.name: Seepstone Grottos
underground_biomes.placement: High groundwater zones, moist hillsides, river valleys and below wetlands
underground_biomes.geometry: Moderate round chambers, narrow connecting passages, water dripping from ceilings
hazards: slick edges and occasional flooded dead ends
underground_biomes.notes: Wet stone along seep paths and ceilings, calcite in veins, small water pools in low basins.

underground_biomes.name: Underflow Channels
underground_biomes.placement: Near river networks, low valleys, aquifers and floodplains; underground flow follows low hydraulic head
underground_biomes.geometry: Meandering tunnels with rounded erosion profiles, occasional high-roofed river rooms
hazards: water currents and dark flooded stretches
underground_biomes.notes: Water occupies channel floor paths; sediment on inside river bends and low-velocity banks, not all walls.

underground_biomes.name: Hollowstone Vaults
underground_biomes.placement: Limestone provinces below Hollowstone Karst and Whitecliff Coast, regardless of surface vegetation
underground_biomes.geometry: Wide vaulted limestone chambers, drop shafts, shelves and vertical erosion chimneys
underground_biomes.notes: Large chambers 12–40 radius uncommon; columns form at paired ceiling/floor positions; calcite concentrated around flowstone.

underground_biomes.name: Coalshade Galleries
underground_biomes.placement: Ancient sedimentary basins and beneath badland or plains rock formations
underground_biomes.geometry: Broad but low-ceilinged horizontal rooms, banded walls and layered passageways
underground_biomes.notes: Coal ore forms veins in host shale and sandstone; fossil shale appears in horizontal strata, not arbitrary speckles.

underground_biomes.name: Saltveil Chambers
underground_biomes.placement: Arid sedimentary basins, deserts and former dried lakebeds only; not below ordinary granite mountains
underground_biomes.geometry: Dry rounded chambers with short side pockets, white crystalline crusts and compact passage networks
hazards: brittle ceiling sections and scarce water
underground_biomes.notes: Rock salt in coherent veins; selenite crystals at rare chamber corners; dry and nearly plant-free.

underground_biomes.name: Frostvault Crevasses
underground_biomes.placement: Only shallow beneath frozen tundra, snowfields or glaciers; geothermal warmth makes deep frost caves uncommon
underground_biomes.geometry: Narrow blue crevasses, shallow ice tunnels, snow-covered vents and a few ice domes
underground_biomes.notes: Ice bodies attached to glaciers, not deep caves under hot regions; icicles grow on ceilings that are cold and exposed.

underground_biomes.name: Ironfault Chasms
underground_biomes.placement: Fault zones and uplifted mountain roots; intersect several deeper rock provinces
underground_biomes.geometry: Tall fractured rifts, sloping fault ledges and diagonal seams with cross-cutting tunnels
underground_biomes.notes: Narrow vertical fissures; ore probabilities follow fault corridors via a multiplier (do not paint ore as 10% of wall).

underground_biomes.name: Crystal Seam Chambers
underground_biomes.placement: Small mineralized pockets near deep intrusive rock and old fault systems; not every deep cave
underground_biomes.geometry: Small geode-like pockets and irregular branching vein caverns, never huge uniform crystal halls
resources: rare diamond-bearing country rock nearby, not guaranteed
hazards: sharp drops and fragile crystal ledges
underground_biomes.notes: Only a few crystal-lined pockets per large region, clusters grow from mineral host rock; avoid full fluorescent walls.

underground_biomes.name: Sporelight Hollows
underground_biomes.placement: Stable, humid chambers with nutrient-bearing seepage and no active lava, preferably below wet forests and marsh basins
underground_biomes.geometry: Sheltered round caves with low terraces, spongy floors, dripping ceilings and sheltered mushroom groves
hazards: dense spore clouds in selected pockets
underground_biomes.notes: Low-light, humid chambers; glowing growths small and scattered, most surfaces remain dark.

underground_biomes.name: Cindervein Tubes
underground_biomes.placement: Volcanic provinces or ancient buried lava pathways; inactive tubes much more frequent than exposed magma
underground_biomes.geometry: Long tube-like tunnels, stacked flow terraces and rare branching vent chambers
hazards: local heat zones, rare exposed lava
underground_biomes.notes: Lava pockets 0–4% only near active systems, vents 0–2 per large cave; most tubes are cooled.

underground_biomes.name: Stillwater Abyss
underground_biomes.placement: Only where deep groundwater basins or large interconnected cave systems make a stable water body plausible
underground_biomes.geometry: Broad low flooded basins, deep dark subterranean lakes and side beaches; no ubiquitous full-depth subterranean ocean
underground_biomes.notes: Large lake chambers, high water fill (2–12 blocks deep typical), dry rim path around some portions, underwater ledges.

depth_biases.coal_ore: shallow to mid; in sedimentary rock

resource_rules.note: Illustrative balance targets only; calibrate to world height, mining speed, chunk size and inventory progression.

implementation_notes: Place dominant blocks using global-coordinate coherent noise patches (about 4-18 block diameters), not independent per-block weighted rolls.
Generate broad geology and surface shape before cave volumes; cave biome weights are applied only to host-rock/depth eligible regions.
Blend biomes by gradually shifting block weights over ~16-48 horizontal blocks, preserving clear location identity.
For grass_top assign grass_side for vertical block sides; dry_grass_top uses dry_grass_side; log tops and sides use matching species textures.
Avoid a grass block side directly on cave stone surfaces or ceiling tops unless soil exists there.
Aquifers and streams occupy already-carved geometry; do not include water in wall palette.
Tall flowers, tall grass, icicles and hanging roots must use their dedicated sprite geometry/texture aspect ratios; never treat as full 32x32 cubes.
Performance: chunk seeds/global world coords, precomputed climate/geology, staged cave carver, chunk boundary halo and deterministic random seeds.
